description: LAN not working in room. Cannot connect to internet via cable.
Ceiling fan stopped working. Room is very hot especially at night.
resolution_notes: Fan motor replaced and tested working.

description: Washroom tap dripping continuously. Water wasted throughout the day.
resolution_notes: Tap washer replaced. No further leakage.

description: Corridor dustbin overflowing. Not emptied for three consecutive days.
WiFi signal very weak. Unable to attend online lectures from room.
Study table leg broken. Table wobbles and cannot be used for writing.
Power socket sparking when plugging in charger. Clear safety hazard.
resolution_notes: Faulty socket replaced immediately on same day.

description: Washroom drain blocked. Water stagnates after bathing.
resolution_notes: Drain cleared with wire tool. Water flows normally.

description: Dustbin in room damaged. Cannot hold waste. Smell spreading.
Tube light flickering constantly. Affecting study and causing eye strain.
Wardrobe door hinge broken. Door falls if opened fully.
No water supply in washroom since morning. Tap completely dry.
resolution_notes: Blocked inlet pipe cleared. Water supply restored.

description: LAN port in room not working. Ethernet cable shows no connection.
Room door lock stiff and hard to open. Key sometimes gets stuck.
resolution_notes: Lock lubricated and spare key prepared.

description: Main ceiling light not working. Only personal table lamp available.
Pest insects noticed near window and under bed. Needs pest treatment.
Chair seat cracked along the middle. Uncomfortable and unsafe to sit.
Toilet flush not operating properly. Requires multiple attempts each use.
No internet access in entire C Block wing. Router may be down.
resolution_notes: Router rebooted and firmware updated. Service restored.

description: Window glass cracked. Risk of injury and security concern at night.
Extension board in common room emitting burning smell. Switched off.
resolution_notes: Overloaded board replaced with correctly rated unit.

description: Hot water not available during morning slot. Geyser possibly faulty.
Mould forming on bathroom wall near shower. Unhygienic condition.
Mattress torn with spring exposed. Causes discomfort and risk of injury.
WiFi password stopped working after network reset. No device connects.
Ceiling paint peeling and falling onto bed. Dampness suspected from above.
